skill.displayName: QR Code Generation And Recognition - 二维码生成识别

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: jisu-qrcode
Version: 1.0.2

The skill is a standard API wrapper for the Jisu Data QR code service (api.jisuapi.com). The Python script (qrcode.py) correctly handles environment variables for authentication and uses the requests library to interact with the official API endpoints for generating and recognizing QR codes without any signs of malicious execution, data exfiltration, or prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and required credential (JISU_API_KEY) are consistent with a QR code generate/recognize integration against the Jisu API; nothing in the bundle indicates hidden or unrelated access.

dimensions.detail: Name/description promise (generate/read QR codes, list templates) matches the code and SKILL.md. The only requested credential (JISU_API_KEY) is exactly what the upstream API needs, and the code calls api.jisuapi.com/qrcode endpoints.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and the script only reference the expected inputs, environment variable JISU_API_KEY, and network calls to the documented Jisu endpoints. The instructions do not ask the agent to read unrelated files or transmit data to unexpected endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec (instruction-only), which minimizes install risk. The Python script uses the requests library but the skill does not declare installing it; callers must ensure python3 and requests are available. No downloads or external installers are performed by the skill.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only JISU_API_KEY is required and is necessary to authenticate with the Jisu API. No other secrets, unrelated credentials, or system config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is not always-enabled and does not request elevated persistent privileges or modify other skills. Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) but not combined with other concerning factors.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is coherent: it sends your JISU_API_KEY to the documented Jisu API endpoints to generate/read QR codes. Before installing, confirm you trust the Jisu service and that the API key you provide has only the permissions you intend. Ensure the runtime has python3 and the 'requests' package available (the script uses requests but does not install it). Note the key will be transmitted to api.jisuapi.com as a query parameter over HTTPS—avoid supplying a highly privileged or shared secret if you don't trust the provider. Finally, because the skill can be invoked autonomously (platform default), be mindful of which agents or workflows are allowed to call it.
